note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its clause lines and the claim are generic placeholders, never real contract text or real claims. "Claim covered as per supplied data" and "Scope disputed (as supplied)" are supplied statuses of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke; the scope outline has the same colour and width, solid or dashed). No indemnity doctrine is stated: no duty to indemnify or pay, no decision on cover beyond the supplied datum, no amount unless supplied (always labelled hypothetical), no outcome and no jurisdiction; "scope disputed" stays an allegation. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions and priorities; clauses = the supplied clause lines, promise = the line holding the promise of cover.
